description: This file defines various provider instances and lifecycle observers for a Flutter app using Riverpod state management. It sets up dependency injection for database, repositories, synchronization services, connectivity monitoring, and app lifecycle handling. It also manages app resume and connectivity change events to trigger synchronization actions.

classes.name: _AppLifecycleObserver
classes.description: A class implementing WidgetsBindingObserver to trigger synchronization actions when app lifecycle states change, specifically on app resume.

methods.name: didChangeAppLifecycleState
methods.description: Handles app lifecycle changes; triggers synchronization when app is resumed.

methods.name: onResumed
methods.description: Callback to invoke sync action when the app resumes.
